posts.name: Velozity
posts.tagline: The Multiplayer AI Office where your team and agents work.
posts.description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

posts.name: GenPage 3.0
posts.tagline: Build, personalize, and optimize landing pages with AI
posts.description: Your marketing campaigns are personalized. Your landing pages should be too. GenPage learns your brand, builds dedicated pages for every ad, keyword, or target account, then continuously A-Z tests them on Autopilot - turning more traffic into pipeline and revenue.

posts.name: IrisGo for Solopreneurs
posts.tagline: AI workflow automation: show it once, let it run
posts.description: IrisGo helps solopreneurs automate recurring work. Get daily briefs, triage email, track to-dos, and turn demonstrated tasks into reusable workflows with Watch & Learn. Spend less time on admin and more time building your business. Free during beta.

posts.name: Databench by Alkera
posts.tagline: Open-source collaborative agentic workspace for data teams
posts.description: Databench by Alkera is the open-source, multiplayer workspace for data science, analytics, and engineering. Collaborate live alongside teammates and agents in notebooks and chats, run any cell or agent on your laptop, another computer, or a GPU node and launch many agents in parallel to explore ideas. Every result traces back to the data and code behind it. Try it at https://alkera.ai with a generous free tier or host Databench yourself (https://github.com/AlkeraAI/Databench).

posts.name: Pegasus 1.6 by TwelveLabs
posts.tagline: Transforms egocentric video into robot training data
posts.description: Pegasus 1.6 is the TwelveLabs model that understands video from a first-person point of view, built for the egocentric and teleoperated footage robotics and physical AI teams already collect. It recognizes entities more accurately, and produces persistent metadata across segment types. Point it at raw teleoperation or wearable footage and get back labeled, timestamped, robot-ready data. No manual labeling pass required.

posts.name: Figma Agent
posts.tagline: Prompt, edit and prototype without leaving the canvas
posts.description: Figma's agent lives right on the Design canvas and works with your real components, variables and team files, not flat images. Generate layout directions, bulk-edit across screens, turn comments into changes and build prototypes from a prompt. Pull context from Notion, Slack, GitHub and Linear via MCP, build your own plugins and shaders, and save repeatable workflows as skills your team runs with "/". Stay in flow from idea to review.

posts.name: Supademo AI Demo Agent
posts.tagline: Agentic demos like your best salesperson, without the salary
posts.description: Most AI demo agents feel like a video call where the other side isn't really listening. Silly animated avatar or obvious fake person on the other end. You ask a question, they keep talking. You try to navigate, but you're just watching their screen. Why bother? Supademo's AI Demo Agent is the opposite. Buyers click through real interactive demos hands-on, take any path, jump back, skip ahead. The agent listens, answers the actual question, surfaces the right proof. Voice or text, 50+ languages.

posts.name: Mistral Large 4
posts.tagline: Mistral's 1T parameter open weight frontier model
posts.description: Mistral Large 4 (aka Le Chonk) is Mistral's largest model yet: a natively multimodal mixture of experts model with 1T total and 49B active parameters and a 1M token context window. Mistral says it is the strongest open weight model from the US or Europe, and it ranks top 5 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. It was trained in Mistral's own European datacenters. The preview API is live today on Mistral Studio, with open weights due by the end of October.

posts.name: Rool
posts.tagline: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace.
posts.description: Rool is your private AI workspace. Bring your files, ideas and AI together in one place, on your own machine in the cloud. Unlike mainstream AI, Rool never sells your data, shows no ads and never uses your content to train AI. Your data is stored in Finland, under EU law. It's AI that runs on your terms, with full control and privacy. Built for privacy-conscious individuals, teams and creators. Try Rool free and own your AI.

posts.name: Ownfeed
posts.tagline: A social feed of people who need your product
posts.description: Paste your product's URL. Every day, Ownfeed reads Reddit, X, Bluesky and Hacker News and keeps only the posts from people who need what you built. No keywords, no alert inbox, no auto-replies. You scroll for five minutes and reply yourself.

posts.name: Introducing Video Editor in Manus 2.0
posts.tagline: Anyone Can Now Make A Video Worth Posting
posts.description: Manus 2.0 introduces Video Editor, making professional-looking video creation accessible to everyone. After a month of daily use, Manus has been used to create launch films, game trailers, news explainers, beat-synced animations, and even edit travel footage. The new Video Editor combines Manus’ AI video capabilities with powerful editing workflows, helping anyone turn ideas and raw footage into polished videos worth posting.

posts.name: Nano Banana 2.1
posts.tagline: Google's image model with sharper design and mask editing
posts.description: Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's latest image generation and editing model. Google says it outperforms earlier Nano Banana models across the board, with better visual design, mask based editing, stronger subject consistency and more natural looking images. It also improves text rendering and consistency across turns, with Search grounding at 1K, 2K and 4K. Try it in Google AI Studio or the Gemini app, or build with it in the Gemini API and Google Cloud.

posts.name: Proofsource
posts.tagline: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps
posts.description: When a buyer asks ChatGPT for the best tool in your category, it names five or six companies and stops. Proofsource shows whether you're one of them. It asks your buyers' questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews every day, shows who gets named instead and why, maps the pages AI trusts, and drafts the fixes. You approve; our agents publish, verify the answers changed, and learn from every change. Start free: 25 questions, 4 engines, no card.

posts.name: ParakeetAI 2.0
posts.tagline: The ultimate way to prepare for your job interview
posts.description: ParakeetAI takes you from "what will they ask?" to "I nailed it." Start with the Question Bank: real interview questions grouped by company and ranked by how often they come up. Rehearse them out loud with an AI interviewer that asks, listens and follows up on your answers, then read the transcript back. On the day, ParakeetAI listens to the real interview and drafts your answers live. Your first mock interview is free.

posts.name: Rhem Labs
posts.tagline: Health assistant robots for your parents’
posts.description: Aging at home has a visibility problem. Small changes in health and routine can go unnoticed for weeks or months, until the first obvious sign is something serious. Rhem is a tabletop robot that helps families see those changes earlier, while giving parents the everyday support they need to stay independent longer. Rhem was designed first for aging parents, but anyone can use it as an extra set of eyes and everyday help at home.

posts.name: Knuff App
posts.tagline: Family check-in app to know your people are okay
posts.description: Knuff is a family check-in app that makes it easy to see how your loved ones are doing, even when life gets busy. Create a bubble with your most important people and share quick check-ins to stay connected wherever life takes you. For families and friend groups of all ages. Core features free, optional paid add-ons available. For iOS and Android.

posts.name: DevAlly AI Agent
posts.tagline: User journeys captured with natural language
posts.description: Describe a user journey in plain English. The DevAlly Agent navigates your app and records a user journey, saving hours of engineering work. The DevAlly platform then audits each stage of journey against the WCAG criterion and suggests fixes for every issue. Constant changes, requires consistent accessibility monitoring. Our agent does it for you.

posts.name: Ana by Vertice
posts.tagline: The AI negotiation agent for software purchases
posts.description: Ana runs software negotiations on your behalf. It reads your requirements, builds the strategy, drafts every email and tracks every round, updating the plan the moment a vendor responds. Trained on $75bn+ of vendor spend, 32,000+ vendors and 2M+ price points. Procurement buyers using Ana achieve 18% savings on average. Built by Vertice.

posts.name: Redlamp
posts.tagline: Native, open-source RAW Lightroom alternative editor for Mac
posts.description: Redlamp is a native, open-source RAW photo editor for Apple Silicon, built from scratch in Swift and Metal. Lightroom's workflow, with no subscription and no cloud.

posts.name: Temp Mail
posts.tagline: Disposable email + private forwarding to your real inbox
posts.description: Temp Mail is back with a big update. Get a free disposable email in one click (no sign-up) for trials, downloads and newsletters. What's new: • Forwarding aliases (Android): hand out a private address, mail lands in your real inbox in seconds, the sender never sees it • Verification codes copied in a tap • Pick your own username and domain, reuse the inbox later • 29 languages, incl. right-to-left Arabic and Urdu • Ad-free website

posts.name: Wabi
posts.tagline: A new kind of messenger that gets things done
posts.description: a new kind of messenger that makes apps and gets things done for you and your friends. We’re building the OS for the agentic era - software that adapts to your life, gets things done, and makes more room for the people and things that matter.

posts.name: Zavi
posts.tagline: Lovable for growth
posts.description: Lovable made building an app feel like typing a sentence. Getting people to use what you built still feels like a full-time job. That’s the gap Zavi is for. Paste your URL and Zavi gives you a growth score and the biggest thing holding you back. Then, if you want, it does the work itself and shows you what moved. For launch, Zavi is running Upcar’s growth for 30 days with $25K of real money and no pause button. Every decision is public.

posts.name: Unprompt
posts.tagline: Your AI usage in dollars and liters of water
posts.description: From the local logs of Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, Unprompt shows your AI usage as tokens, dollars at API prices and liters of water. The Mac companion is free. On iPhone, Unprompt counts how often you use your AI apps, through Screen Time. Work hours are shown separately. Compare your month with friends. Today's tokens and cost are free. The 30-day card with water comes with Premium.

posts.name: Plugins Radar
posts.tagline: Search rankings and competitor alerts for ChatGPT plugins
posts.description: Plugins Radar tracks the ChatGPT plugin directory. Look up any of 5,000+ plugins to see where it ranks in 192 common searches, which plugins compete with it and which searches it misses. Add your plugin and the rivals you watch, and get an email when one passes you or edits its listing. Topic leaderboards are free. Sign up free and track a plugin to see its full report.

posts.name: Linda
posts.tagline: Your local AI coworker for the Mac, like Dots but free!
posts.description: Linda is a free, private AI coworker for your Mac. Say or type what you need and it does the work in its own browser and your folders: research, price checks, pages, sheets, renamed files, replies. Set up specialists, like a Researcher or a Bookkeeper, with their own instructions and skills. Watch every step in the Computer column and take over any time. It runs local AI on Apple Silicon or uses your own key, and asks before it sends, buys, deletes or posts. No account.

posts.name: Lofi Desk 2.0
posts.tagline: A pixel-art focus companion and a room you decorate
posts.description: Lofi Desk is a focus timer in a pixel-art room, where PC GIRL works right next to you. 2.0 is our biggest update yet: 🪙 Focus coins — earned for every minute you focus 🛋️ Room decor — spend coins on furniture and make the room yours 👕 Outfits for PC GIRL ✨ Every animation hand-redrawn in pixel art 🎧 Lofi music, rain / café / forest / fireplace ambience, Pomodoro and a focus log Premium is a one-time purchase. No subscription.

posts.name: Albie
posts.tagline: An AI tutor that teaches at a whiteboard, not a chat box
posts.description: Albie teaches on a whiteboard you share: you write with a pen, he reads your handwriting and draws as he explains. Talk or chat with him. He gives quick quizzes, sets homework, codes with you, opens your web projects in-lesson, and builds small apps.

posts.name: Viibeo
posts.tagline: One prompt to a publish-ready faceless short
posts.description: Viibeo turns a prompt, page URL, or script into a publish-ready faceless short with a hook-led script, voiceover, B-roll, and timed captions. Export a 9:16 MP4 or use Autopilot to run recurring content for supported social channels. Inspiration Feed helps you find formats worth remaking, while Ad Factory turns product stills into short ad creatives. Your first video is free with a watermark; paid plans start at $19/month.

posts.name: Basedash Mobile
posts.tagline: Ask your data out loud, right from your Home Screen.
posts.description: Basedash Mobile puts your AI data analyst on your iPhone Home Screen. Add it from Safari in a few taps, hit the mic, and ask out loud — "Which region grew fastest this month?" — to get the answer and a chart in seconds. Tap any bar to drill in by country, plan, or rep, then scrub a trend with your thumb. Sales, finance, support, and ops can check the numbers from a hallway, an airport, or a customer meeting. Your data, in your pocket. Just ask out loud.

posts.name: Reika
posts.tagline: A coding agent CLI designed around small local models first
posts.description: Reika is a coding agent CLI for local and hosted models, designed around local models first. It doesn't make a small model more intelligent but it provides a better experience using them day to day. Even if you're not part of the absolute range that Reika is designed for, using larger local models or hosted ones will still provide a solid experience out of the box.

posts.name: Walrus Console
posts.tagline: Store, Protect and Connect Your Data
posts.description: Put your data to work across apps and AI tools, and keep building on it as your stack evolves. Walrus Console pairs familiar file management with an AI-ready data foundation that is portable, programmable, and verifiable. Free up to 5 GB.

posts.name: StudyQuest
posts.tagline: Turn your notes into games
posts.description: Turn PDFs, slides, images, or pasted notes into AI-generated questions, then learn through 40+ games. Battle bosses, race friends, or practice solo using your own material. Teachers can review a question set once, share it for independent play, or host it live with the class. Free plan available.

posts.name: DailyHub
posts.tagline: A personal command center for projects, tasks, and habits.
posts.description: A personal command center for people who juggle more than one project at a time — founders, consultants, indie builders, anyone with client work, side projects, and a few non-negotiable daily habits. DailyHub is not a replacement for Linear, Jira, or Notion. It is the morning surface: what is open, what belongs where, what must happen today, and what you already finished.

posts.name: ImageFlow
posts.tagline: Free Photoshop-grade image editor with AI features
posts.description: A free, full-featured image editor that runs entirely in your browser. Layers, masks, blend modes, adjustment layers, smart objects, text and filters — with PSD import and export, and on-device AI selection. Nothing is uploaded; your files never leave your device.

posts.name: Postquel
posts.tagline: Free native Postgres app for Mac with your own AI agents
posts.description: A fast, native PostgreSQL client for macOS. Its AI assistant runs on the Claude Code, Codex or Cursor account you already pay for, sees your real schema, and can only read: any change it suggests waits for you to dry-run and apply. Free and open source.

posts.name: Aura by Neural
posts.tagline: Turn requests into interactive interfaces on your screen
posts.description: A new way to work and create on Mac and Windows. Speak or type, and Aura turns your requests into interactive interfaces on your screen. Bring your files, explore ideas, compare options, and create finished work. Keep talking, and shape what you see.

posts.name: Thalia
posts.tagline: Plan, approve and review your Muse Code agent on Mac
posts.description: Thalia is a free native Mac app for Meta's Muse Code CLI. Plan mode restarts Muse read-only until you approve the plan. Every command is shown in full, step by step, before Allow. Review lets you run your checks and approve the exact snapshot, and any later edit invalidates it. Checkpoints, MCP connectors, voice mode and an embedded terminal are built in. Uses your own Muse access, sends no telemetry, and runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27.

posts.name: Vresk
posts.tagline: One AI workspace that offers the best open source models
posts.description: Vresk is one AI workspace for open models, from Kimi and DeepSeek to Qwen and Llama. Auto picks the best model for each task, and your notes, history and memory stay in your workspace, so you can switch models without starting over. Ask for an answer, a live widget or a designed deck. Every reply names the model that wrote it. Free to try, $20/mo flat.

posts.name: Flowo
posts.tagline: ADHD day planner that re-plans when your day slips
posts.description: Most planners help you make a plan. Flowo helps when the plan stops matching the day. It builds your day from tasks, fixed events and limits like sleep and meals, then rebuilds what is left when something runs long, and shows what moved and why. Brain dump by typing or voice, habits that scale down in hard weeks, and a Pomodoro timer that starts from the plan. No account; planning data stays encrypted on your phone. Free on iPhone and Android, with an optional Pro plan.

posts.name: Featherweight Dictation
posts.tagline: Dictation that weighs nothing, for Mac and Windows
posts.description: Hold a key, talk, let go: your words land where your cursor is, ums gone and laid out for the app you're in, an email, a chat line, a list or a prompt. 4.6 MB on a Mac, 2.3 MB on Windows, 0% CPU while it waits. $5 a month after a free trial.

posts.name: Takweem AI
posts.tagline: The AI calendar that makes room for your most important work
posts.description: Takweem is an AI-first calendar. Ask in plain language, or by voice, to find time, move meetings or protect focus. You see every change before it counts: requests that only touch your own time are applied at once with Undo, and anything involving other people waits for your approval. It adapts when plans change, holds a weekly focus goal, and offers team availability and booking links where AI picks the best time. Integrates with Google Calendar — Outlook coming soon.

posts.name: SunSed
posts.tagline: The first AI app builder with a language made for AI
posts.description: Other platforms make AI write in languages designed for human programmers. SunSed's language was designed for AI: fewer decisions per step, up to 20x fewer tokens, far fewer errors, richer apps. You can master it in an afternoon. Batteries included: hosting and CDN, database, logins with 2FA, email, file storage, Stripe payments with 0% platform fee, scheduled jobs, custom domains, 60+ integrations. Nothing to wire together. Your live app stays up even when AI credits run out. Free for 7 days.

posts.name: Cinch – Reminders & Tasks
posts.tagline: Clean, privacy-first task manager for Apple Reminders
posts.description: Cinch is a fast, lightweight native client for Apple Reminders across iOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS. Built for the future: CLI for Agents – Give LLMs access to your Reminders while keeping all data local and private. Zero telemetry, zero tracking, and no custom databases. Your data stays strictly in your personal iCloud. Clean layout with generous spacing, visual daily timelines, calendar integration, natural language input, and interactive widgets.

posts.name: Vanoor
posts.tagline: Turn your Apple Watch into a serious running watch
posts.description: Vanoor turns your Apple Watch into a proper running watch. Follow GPX routes with a tap and a spoken cue before every turn, pace your race split by split, and run structured workouts with pace or heart-rate targets, built in the app or planned by your AI assistant. Afterwards, every split is scored by how closely you ran the plan. Fueling reminders, spoken cues in 11 languages, saves to Apple Health and Strava. No account, no subscription: 7 days free, then buy once.

posts.name: Awesome Popups
posts.tagline: Turn any Webflow element into a popup.
posts.description: Stop pasting popup widgets into sites you spent weeks designing. With Awesome Popups, you build the popup in the Webflow Designer, then add triggers (exit intent, scroll, time, click), targeting, frequency caps and multi-step flows. Built-in analytics show what actually converts. Works with Webflow forms, Zapier and webhooks.

posts.name: Captions Bro
posts.tagline: Auto Captions, Video Editor & Teleprompter
posts.description: Captions Bro is more than an auto-caption app — it combines on-device transcription, a built-in teleprompter, and a full multi-track video editor in one iPhone/iPad workflow. Record your script, generate and style captions, edit clips, add overlays, transitions, and effects, then export for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. No switching between separate caption, teleprompter, and editing apps.

posts.name: Klar
posts.tagline: AI Spam filter for Apple Mail
posts.description: AI spam filter for Apple Mail. Runs locally on your Mac. Private by design.

posts.name: convt
posts.tagline: Convert any file with a right-click, without uploading it
posts.description: Most file converters make you upload your files to a website. convt runs on your own computer instead. Right-click a photo, video, audio file or document, pick a format, and the new file appears next to the original. It handles 40 formats, from HEIC and MOV to PDF and DOCX, works offline and converts whole folders at once. Want more control? Set quality and size in the app, or script it with the convt command line tool. Open source, with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: LinkToast
posts.tagline: Partner walls your visitors can actually verify
posts.description: Anyone can put any logo on their website, and visitors know it. So even real partnerships get scrolled past. We built LinkToast so partner logos mean something again. You add a partner, they get a quick request, and once they approve, their logo shows up on your site with a verified badge Click it and you see it's real. One line of code, then it updates itself. Free to start.

posts.name: erxes | Everything
posts.tagline: Your business need — Frontline, Sales, Ops, Content - all in
posts.description: erxes | Everything is an open-source experience operating system for growing teams. ✔️ Frontline: every conversation (email, chat, social, SMS, form) in one inbox ✔️ Sales: runs your pipeline ✔️ Operation: projects, tasks, cycles ✔️ Content: powers your website ✔️ AI agents built into every module ✔️ Cloud or self-hosted: your data, your control ✔️ No per-seat pricing: one price for your whole team for $99 per month, $250 per month with AI agents build in.

posts.name: Subturtle
posts.tagline: Speak the English you hear and read, anywhere online
posts.description: Learn English from what you already watch and read. Hover a subtitle on YouTube or Netflix, or select text on any web page, and see what it means in your own language, idioms and all. Save the phrase with the sentence it came from. Smart Review brings it back at the right time, as a gap in your own sentence, so it sticks. Then an AI voice coach practices those exact phrases with you out loud, so the words are there when you need them.

posts.name: Vanpelt.studio | The $29 Youtube team
posts.tagline: A Youtube creation expert team in a local desktop app
posts.description: Creating Youtube videos is hard and requires a lot of skills which is why a lot of big creator have a team for that purpose. What if you could also have a strategist who finds the videos your audience already wants, a writer, two editors and a packaging designer ? Vanpelt Studio is all five, for only $29 a month vs the average $10k you'd spent on an average staff. Beginners trying to get started with the best practices or expert looking to cut down workload, the studio accommodates everyone.

posts.name: VDF AI Agents
posts.tagline: From a sentence to a production agent
posts.description: Build enterprise AI agents in plain English. Describe what you need, review the generated draft, and confirm. No code, no configuration files. Run agents on small models, on-premises or in the cloud. Orchestrate multiple agents around your workflows, connect your tools with native integrations, and work hands-free with multilingual voice dictation. Flat pricing, no token surprises or hidden costs.

posts.name: Worthiness
posts.tagline: Customer credit score check, built for India's loan DSAs
posts.description: Worthiness is a credit score check and loan eligibility check for India's loan DSAs, dealers and brokers. One consented request returns the customer's credit score from India's top three credit bureaus, shows who else has checked the file, and gives a verdict for every loan product on your panel, from lender rules you set. Consent is one SMS and a six-digit code. Customer data is never sold or shared, and is encrypted in transit and at rest. Pay per check, with no subscription.

posts.name: MarketOwl
posts.tagline: AI marketer with its own Reddit and X profiles for DMs
posts.description: MarketOwl finds and messages potential customers through its own Reddit and X profiles, while routines check for replies and respond to interested people under your rules. Connect any marketing tool with an API: MarketOwl learns to use it. Choose from existing playbooks for outreach, social posts, ads or SEO, written by practicing marketers. MarketOwl executes them in your tools without you writing step-by-step instructions.

posts.name: LoWisa
posts.tagline: Learn with AI, without becoming dependent on it
posts.description: LoWisa is an AI tutor that makes you do the thinking. Turn your notes, slides or a photo of the board into a quiz that explains every miss, flashcards and a two-host podcast you can play offline. Teachers and communities run Cohorts with AI-planned lessons, contests and study rooms. Practise speaking and interviews, or learn to code with a tutor inside your IDE. Free on Android and iPhone.

posts.name: Mudbase BaaS
posts.tagline: The backend that gets your product paid.
posts.description: Building a product shouldn't mean stitching together your backend across different providers and payment infrastructure. Mudbase gives developers the backend infrastructure to build, ship and monetize products, with payments built in. Get authentication, database, storage, realtime, functions, APIs, webhooks and messaging in one backend, then manage the payment lifecycle from checkout to confirmation, access and payout without maintaining a separate payment stack.

posts.name: Everframe
posts.tagline: In-app bug reports with the context developers actually need
posts.description: Everframe replaces the patchwork of bug form, crash reporter, chat thread and task board with a single product. - Capture bugs and crashes from iOS, Android, React Native, web, smart TV and Roku apps. - Let AI triage them and a coding agent propose the fix. - Talk to reporters from the ticket. - Track everything on built-in boards. Fewer tools, fewer handoffs, and a clear path from the moment something breaks to the moment it is fixed.

posts.name: Quick Presenter
posts.tagline: A lightweight cross-platform presenter for PDF slides
posts.description: Quick Presenter is a lightweight cross-platform presenter tool for PDF slide decks, built for academic talks, research presentations, technical conferences, and online presentations over tools such as Zoom and Google Meet. Quick Presenter focuses on one job: open a PDF slide deck and help the speaker present it reliably. It is not a slide editor, a deck authoring tool, or a document management app.

posts.name: superemotion
posts.tagline: Emotionally intelligent AI that remembers everything
posts.description: An emotionally intelligent AI that understands your emotions, your relationships and what you are going through — and carries that understanding from one conversation to the next.

posts.name: GSS - GPU Style Sheets
posts.tagline: Write 3D scenes in CSS, compiled to one GPU shader
posts.description: GSS is a 3D language for people who already speak CSS. Declare shapes in a @scene, style them with selectors, the cascade, custom properties, and @keyframes, and the compiler turns it all into a single raymarching shader (GLSL for WebGL2, WGSL for WebGPU). No Three.js, no meshes, no UVs. Drop a tag on any page, or try it live in the playground. Open source, Apache 2.0.

posts.name: Softrixa
posts.tagline: Free AI App Builder — Build websites & apps by chatting
posts.description: Softrixa is a free AI agent that builds complete websites, web apps and games from a chat prompt. Live preview, code view, one-file or ZIP download. Powered by RRR PRO MEX.

posts.name: TongueTied
posts.tagline: A 60-second daily dash across languages
posts.description: We're a word game that embraces a multilingual, multicultural world. Once a day you’ll have 60 seconds to unscramble the same word in six languages. Test your polyglotism and share the results – boast, learn, and talk with friends about the languages you know or want to know. Free to play, no ads, no need to sign in.

posts.name: fundsvisor
posts.tagline: Books that file themselves. No accountant needed.
posts.description: Fundsvisor is a modern invoicing and expense tracker for freelancers and small businesses. Snap a receipt and AI reads the merchant, amount, and category. Send a branded invoice and track delivery + payment. Get plain-English report, Money Summary, Income vs Expenses, P&L, Balance Sheet without ever touching a debit or credit. Pakistan businesses get one-click FBR e-invoicing. Web, iOS, Android. Free plan + 14-day business trial.

posts.name: SuperQuest
posts.tagline: Your website. Activated.
posts.description: Activate your website visitors and turn them into leads. Create compelling interactive user experiences in minutes: Product finders, tests, calculators, surveys, mini games and much more. Route leads directly to your CRM or email with easy setup.

posts.name: Sippo
posts.tagline: Water reminder app for Mac
posts.description: Sippo is a water reminder app for Mac. A friendly buddy pops up in the corner of your screen when it's time to drink. 14 days free, then US$14.99 once.

posts.name: Cropped
posts.tagline: Capture, annotate, trim & compress screenshots and videos
posts.description: Cropped is a native screenshot, annotation and screen recording app with a full image and video optimizer built in. Snap an area, window or screen, record at up to 60 fps, mark it up, then export WebP, AVIF, MP4, WebM or GIF at a fraction of the size. Drag results from the floating Drop window straight into Slack, Mail or a browser. Runs locally, originals untouched. Mac & Windows (capture on Apple Silicon first). $24.99 once, updates for life, 14-day free trial with no signup.

posts.name: Zas
posts.tagline: Send files, text and code. It deletes itself in 5 days.
posts.description: Zas moves files, photos, text and code between your devices and to other people. Nothing to install and no account to start: open zas.red and paste. A universal clipboard: copy on your phone, paste on your computer. Directo sends up to 10 GB device to device. Everything is encrypted on your device before upload and deletes itself in 5 days unless you pin it. Your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, any MCP client) can send too. Web, Android and iOS. Free to use — a corridor, not a warehouse.

posts.name: afterthebeep.fm
posts.tagline: An answerphone for kind messages from strangers
posts.description: Anonymous voice messages of encouragement, left by strangers for whoever needs one. Press play.

posts.name: Thepatient AI
posts.tagline: AI Patient Simulator
posts.description: Thepatient.ai is an AI-powered clinical simulation platform that helps medical students practice patient encounters, clinical reasoning, and OSCE-style cases anytime. Instead of only reading textbooks or memorizing question banks, students can interact with realistic AI patients: take a history, ask follow-up questions, request physical examinations and investigations, form a differential diagnosis, and build a treatment plan.

posts.name: Melo
posts.tagline: A quiet space online for sound, focus, and atmosphere.
posts.description: Melo is a free space to discover sounds for focus, sleep, relaxation, ASMR and everything in between: rain, waves, fireplaces, lo-fi, ambient music and white noise. Pair any sound with one of eight beautiful Ambient Worlds, then go fullscreen and let it fill your screen while you work or unwind. Community upvotes decide what's trending, so you can find what listeners love right now. Every sound is credited to its creator. No sign-in, no ads, completely free.

posts.name: FolioPress
posts.tagline: One website, every language your customers speak
posts.description: FolioPress is a website and blog builder for people who publish in more than one language. Write a page or post in your own language, press Translate, and AI drafts every other language you have switched on. Each language gets its own address, so search engines index every language, not just one. Translate, Summarize and Proofread sit next to every field. Publish now, as a draft or on a date. Use a free foliopress.io address or your own domain. One plan, every feature included.

posts.name: Client Delivery Systems That Scale
posts.tagline: Build repeatable client delivery workflows that scale
posts.description: Building Client Delivery Systems That Scale is a practical guide for freelancers and small service teams that want more consistent project delivery without unnecessary complexity. It covers client onboarding, scope and capacity planning, workflow stages, communication, quality checks, approvals, documentation, and continuous improvement. The focus is on creating a repeatable delivery process that remains flexible enough for real client work.

posts.name: Café Empire
posts.tagline: What if that café were yours?
posts.description: Café Empire turns the daydream into decisions. Set prices, hire staff, handle surprises, and find out whether your coffee-shop idea can become a real business.

posts.name: FlexDropin
posts.tagline: Book one gym class, skip the yearly contract
posts.description: FlexDropin books a single gym class, not a membership. Search gyms near you, filter by discipline, see each class with price and free spots, then pay in the app with card or Apple Pay. No subscription, no credit packs: the money goes straight to the gym. Gyms list one-off or recurring classes for free and pay 15% per booking, with no fixed fees. Free on iOS and Android, in English and Italian.

posts.name: BackEngine Prompt Library
posts.tagline: 105 free AI prompts for go-to-market teams
posts.description: A free library of 105 AI prompts for Sales, CS, RevOps, Marketing, PMM, Product and Founders. Pick your role and goal to get your top picks, then copy one into Claude and ask things like "which accounts look fine but aren't?" Best with BackEngine.

posts.name: PostRoom
posts.tagline: Client approval on the exact caption, before publishing
posts.description: Get a clear client decision on the exact social media caption before publishing. PostRoom gives freelancers and small agencies text/caption review rooms, expiring client links, version-specific approvals or change requests, and an approved-only CSV export. Clients need no account. Free: one room, 10 stored drafts, no card. Keep your existing scheduler; PostRoom does not generate content, publish posts or review visuals.

posts.name: Mundane Read
posts.tagline: News, no dramas
posts.description: Mundane Read keeps the calm on every news site you read. It measures the writing, not the politics. There is no left-right rating and there will not be one. It does not say whether a story is true; it says how it is told. From Mundane Read, calm and anxiety-free news with the loaded words taken out, at mundaneread.com.

posts.name: The Road to Doom
posts.tagline: A place for Marvel fans to track their road through the MCU
posts.description: This tracker is much, much more than a check list. It's a way to quickly catch up on movies you don't have time to watch but want to recap, or see which characters are in what movies and shows. It's a way to track the movies along side your friends, track which movies you own physical copies of, create your own watch list, collect badges, and more! It's a way to prep for Doomsday, but it will last through Secret Wars and beyond.

posts.name: BitsReef
posts.tagline: Push code from Git to a live URL — no lock-in
posts.description: BitsReef is a developer-focused PaaS that makes deploying and managing production apps simple. Connect your Git repo and deploy Docker-based applications with built-in SSL, DNS, scaling, logs, metrics, environment variables, databases, queues, and more. Built for startups, agencies, and growing teams that want production-ready infrastructure without needing a dedicated DevOps team. 🚀

posts.name: GodsView AI
posts.tagline: Live Flight Tracker, Ship, Weather & World Events
posts.description: See what’s happening anywhere in the world, live. GodsView AI brings global events, news, flights, weather, markets and more into one real time map.

posts.name: ProfileProof
posts.tagline: Honest feedback on your dating profile
posts.description: ProfileProof reads your dating profile the way a stranger does. Add your photos and prompts, get a clear written review of what it communicates, then a short ordered list of what to fix first. It never rates your looks, never promises matches and never connects to your dating accounts. Uploads are deleted within 24 hours. Your first snapshot is free.

posts.name: Burrow
posts.tagline: A private budget and journal app with a local AI helper
posts.description: Burrow keeps your budget, journal, todos, habits and notes in one Windows app, saved in a file on your own computer. No account, no tracking, and nothing goes online unless you switch it on. Javi, the built-in helper, runs on your PC. Free, or Pro $49 once.

posts.name: beforewemeet
posts.tagline: Before the first hello. Get to know
posts.description: Answer 10 meaningful questions, share them with your person, and understand your values, mindset, and compatibility before deciding to meet.

posts.name: DeMarkup
posts.tagline: Convert any webpage into clean Markdown with one click
posts.description: Free, open-source Chrome extension that converts any webpage into clean, well-structured Markdown. Smart content extraction, three conversion modes (main content, full page, selection), and an LLM optimization mode that strips noise for AI consumption. Privacy-first — all processing happens locally.

posts.name: ShipX
posts.tagline: Product launch platform for builders under 1K followers
posts.description: ShipX is the product launch platform for builders with fewer than 1,000 followers on X. Launch what you ship, pick a launch week, and get discovered — no audience required.

posts.name: Refill
posts.tagline: Your Claude and Codex limits, watched in the menu bar
posts.description: Refill sits in your Mac menu bar and watches Claude, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and Gemini limits. When a window refills, Drip (a small tank) says so: notch, notification, sound, or a hook you set. Free and open source. No account.

posts.name: UGC Hook Generator
posts.tagline: Reels and TikTok hooks from a curated bank, not a chatbot
posts.description: Pick the platform, product category and angle, and get ten opening lines built from a curated hook bank (pattern interrupt, POV, problem callout, before/after and more). Deterministic, so you get the same quality every time and can iterate on the ones that test well. Copy them straight into a brief.

posts.name: WP Bones
posts.tagline: Laravel-style framework for WordPress plugins
posts.description: WP Bones gives a WordPress plugin the shape of a modern PHP app: service providers, Blade views, Eloquent models, migrations and a bones CLI that scaffolds, renames and deploys. New since the first launch, in 33 releases: • 3.0: secure defaults, admin-only pages, nonces on forms, migrations once per site • A webpack build for React and TypeScript apps • 14 boilerplates you can open in WordPress Playground • 350 tests on PHP 8.1–8.4. Free and open source (LGPL).

posts.name: Session Viewer
posts.tagline: Claude and Codex transcripts into a calm,searchable reading
posts.description: Session Viewer turns the Claude Code and Codex transcripts already on your machine into a calm, searchable reading experience. Browse decisions, recover an implementation detail, compare approaches, and export the useful parts — all without uploading your conversations to a third party.

posts.name: Pool Planner
posts.tagline: Your garden, with a pool in it.
posts.description: Plan your backyard pool before construction starts. Explore sizes, layouts, steps, tanning ledges, spas, decking, and more to see what fits your space. PoolPlanner is a simple visual tool that helps you make expensive pool decisions with more confidence — before you start digging.

posts.name: SleepOmo
posts.tagline: Bedtime stories in your own voice, even when you're away.
posts.description: Tell SleepOmo your child's name, age and what tonight needs (a first day at school, a bad dream, a new sibling) and it writes a brand-new, gentle story around them, then reads it aloud in one of six storyteller voices. On Premium, record your voice once and their stories are told in it, even on nights you can't be there. Press play and the screen dims itself, so they can close their eyes and just listen. Free to start: a new story every night and the full library, no sign-up needed.

posts.name: 1988.in — Feel 1988. No skip.
posts.tagline: Experience the 1988 era of Doordarshan.
posts.description: Instead of reels, feel 1988. A CRT television in the browser with no skip button. The programme is already on. Change the channel, or stay with it.

posts.name: Gatana
posts.tagline: Enterprise MCP, Skills, Artictacts Gateway for Agents
posts.description: Gatana is an MCP gateway that offers turn-key support for skills, SSO, FaaS, OpenAPI, and more. One place for your team's tools, credentials and identity, for every AI agent. It is built to be very flexible from day one, and we thinks it supports any agentic scenario you may have.

posts.name: Zeptap
posts.tagline: Let your AI agents use your iPhone like you do
posts.description: Let your AI agents use your iPhone like you do. Zeptap is a Mac app that lets your agent operate your iPhone like an another computer. Think computer use, but for your iPhone. Give your agent access to up to five iPhones at once, without Xcode or an Apple developer account. Use your existing Claude Code or Codex subscription, or connect through MCP. Anything you can do on your iPhone, your agents can now do too.

posts.name: MAGDOX Code Security
posts.tagline: Security evidence your release owners can read and defend.
posts.description: Scan source code, dependencies, secrets and configuration locally. Review findings, software inventories and application risk in a shared console. Use the MAGDOX CLI or connect your coding assistant through MCP. Upload findings only when you choose.

posts.name: DonorAlpha
posts.tagline: Follow the money in every federal election
posts.description: DonorAlpha follows the outside money in every federal election. Now: every 2026 House and Senate race, with who spent supporting or opposing each candidate and who gave to the groups. Free, nonpartisan, updated nightly. Share any race as a graphic.

posts.name: MacAway
posts.tagline: Locks your Mac when you walk away, no app on your phone
posts.description: MacAway sits in your menu bar and does one thing: it locks your Mac when you walk away. Setup takes a minute. Pick the iPhone or Apple Watch you already carry, and you are done. Nothing to install on the phone, no account, nothing to tune. The menu says in plain words whether you are protected, and one switch pauses it when you want to stay put. If it ever locks while you are still there, it tells you why and offers the one fix. 14 days free, then $14 once for all your Macs.

posts.name: Toolap
posts.tagline: Ready-to-use tools & AI prompts for real work
posts.description: Toolap is a growing library of 100+ ready-to-use professional tools: Excel templates, HTML mini-apps, documents and AI prompts. What makes it different is that many tools also include the prompt used to customize them with AI. Instead of starting from scratch, users can find, download and adapt practical tools for real work across multiple professional categories.

posts.name: EarnCodex
posts.tagline: Compare reward offers using real player data
posts.description: EarnCodex helps people compare game and reward offers across earning platforms before committing their time. See payouts and milestones side by side, then use community-reported progress, spending, completion times and results to understand what an offer is actually like. Instead of only showing what an offer promises, EarnCodex is building a picture of what real players experience.
